raw.detail: Neutralize "red": prompts that ask for it should come out without it (match the empty prompt).

raw.name: bipolar
raw.detail: Classic ++ stretches the color axis past the frozen red direction without dragging stripe.

raw.name: remap
raw.detail: Trained red-direction aligns with frozen blue; stripe hold stays high.

raw.name: keep_erase
raw.detail: ESD plus `stripe#stripe` is the live-DSL way to pin the keep axis. Same geometry as the EA retain hook on this fixture.

raw.name: mix
raw.detail: Write red toward the mixed embedding: red keeps color and picks up stripe. First-class `+` would be a synonym here.

raw.name: isolate
raw.detail: Write the mix onto stripe: `red stripe` lands on e_y. Standalone red/stripe drift is the linear LoRA class, same caveat as the antipodal write swap.
